summary.value: When an enemy within melee range recovers Hit Points or starts its turn with current HP at or below (SL x 10), interrupt

system.description: When an enemy within melee range recovers Hit Points or starts its turn with current HP at or below (SL x 10), interrupt and spend 10 MP to make a free attack against it with an equipped weapon; if it is not reduced to 0 HP, its recovery or turn then resolves normally. Usable once per scene per creature.
